result.summary:
INT-release-config adversary against 30a4065036a917514fb4984fde73f87867f38619 (branch devin/1788854799-production-program-integration). Attack branch devin/pp/adv/release-config-30a40650 @ 1b84cbff786e1c0ddc149cb19e90a04d8ae9d4d1 (one commit on top of the attacked SHA; adds only apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/{releaseConfigDocumentAgreement,releaseIdentityGate,revenueCatKeySelection,thirdPartyNoticesInputs}.adv.test.ts; `git status` otherwise clean — no production code or existing test touched; no PR opened).

RUN (VERIFIED): `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci __tests__/adv/` → exit 1, Test Suites 3 failed/1 passed (4), Tests 13 failed / 51 passed / 0 skipped (64 total). Log: /home/ubuntu/adv-logs/adv-run5.log (verbose per-test list: /home/ubuntu/adv-logs/adv-run6-verbose.log). All 13 failures are the intended reproducers of the 7 breaks above (G2+A2, A4, A9×2, A1, K2×3, A3+G3, G4×2). Hygiene on the new files: `cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0 (after `npm ci`, exit 0, 962 packages; before it 20 pre-existing TS errors from a stale node_modules missing @sentry/react-native, none in adv/); `npx eslint apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/` exit 0; `npx prettier --check __tests__/adv/*.adv.test.ts` clean.

ATTACKS THAT DID NOT BREAK (51 passing, VERIFIED, same command):
- A5/A6/A7/A8 identity agreement: marketing version 1.0 identical in dossier, manifest, every pbxproj configuration and APP_VERSION; every CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION == manifest buildNumber; min iOS 15.1 == every IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET; Info.plist sources both version keys from build settings; single PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER com.picklesensei == dossier == Appfile == diagnostics.bundleIdentifier; DEVELOPMENT_TEAM H26U6W4K6V in all configs == dossier == Appfile; APP_STORE_ID 6806918402 == dossier; entitlements == exactly Sign in with Apple (no push); iPhone-only/portrait-only/arm64; ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption as documented; exactly one URL scheme == reversed GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID; privacy/terms URLs == `${API_BASE_URL}/privacy|/terms` == dossier; Info.plist usage strings carry no forbidden copy; dossier Billing row versions (react-native-purchases, RevenueCat pod, GoogleSignIn pod) match the locks.
- A1 control: Fastfile has no `increment_build_number` / `latest_testflight_build_number(...) +`.
- G1: `node scripts/release-identity.mjs --check --json` exit 0, JSON {marketingVersion 1.0, buildNumber 1, gitSha == git rev-parse HEAD}; `node tools/release/check-release-manifest.mjs` exit 0 'All release-manifest checks passed.'
- G2 refusal wording: `--latest-uploaded 8` refuses with 'greater than 8' and never proposes 9 (no automatic build selection).
- G3 contract pin: a manifest naming the committed production origin is refused by the manifest gate (exit 1) — the gate hard-requires 'tbd'.
- G5 process-death/malformed inputs: manifest truncated mid-write → identity gate exit 1 naming release-manifest.json AND manifest gate non-zero; pbxproj truncated inside Release config → exit 1, no stdout; empty runtimeConfig.ts → exit 1 naming APP_VERSION AND manifest gate exit 1; Info.plist truncated before CFBundleVersion → exit 1 naming CFBundleVersion.
- G6 double action: both gates run twice give byte-identical output, exit 0, and `git status --porcelain -- apps/mobile infra` unchanged (gates never write).
- G7: manifest gate prints its Mac-only exclusions; identity gate does not depend on android/ (exit 0 with android removed) while the manifest gate still requires build.gradle (exit 1).
- K1 RevenueCat selection: Platform.OS ios → 'appl_twORWAKcOeYuEFbvZGOUjnWDrAl' (== dossier), android → test_ key, web/other → null (billing.unconfigured); rest of public config platform-independent. K2 controls: `sk_` secret key refused on ios/android/other before configure; appl_ key configures iOS exactly once.
- N1 notices binding: all 4 receipt inputs (package.json, package-lock.json, ios/Podfile.lock, SwiftPM Package.resolved) sha256 == committed bytes; `node scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs --check` exit 0 and states 'no current-binary clearance is claimed'; validateReceipt on a faithful copy → [].
- N2 coverage: every top-level pod in Podfile.lock (>20) is a `pod:` receipt component at the locked version, no stale pod component, every third-party pod name + 'Sentry Cocoa — 9.24.0 / native:Sentry' present in assets/legal/ThirdPartyNotices.txt.
- N3 fail-closed: Podfile.lock RNSentry version edit → 'Pinned input changed: ios/Podfile.lock'; package-lock.json +1 byte → 'Pinned input changed: package-lock.json'; missing Package.resolved → validator throws ENOENT (exit 1, no success output — fail-closed, though as a crash rather than a listed problem); receipt dropping Podfile.lock → 'Required locked input coverage changed'; native:Sentry version drift → 'Required native component missing/version changed: native:Sentry@9.24.0'; removed bundled font → 'Bundled font coverage changed'.

NOT_YET_VERIFIABLE (needs Mac/M4 runner, Apple credentials or StoreKit; no verdict guessed):
- Which CFBundleVersion Xcode ships for a duplicate-key plist and the post-archive identity check: on the M4 runner `cd apps/mobile/ios && bundle exec fastlane beta` (runs pre-archive gate → build_app → `node ../scripts/release-identity.mjs --check --assert-version <archive CFBundleShortVersionString> --assert-build <archive CFBundleVersion> --assert-git-sha <sha>`); requires ASC API key env; will currently stop at the pre-archive refusal (break #1).
- Final-binary third-party notice membership: `node scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs --check-app <path/to/PickleSensei.app>` on an archived app.
- Actual latest TestFlight build number (documented as 3): `bundle exec fastlane run latest_testflight_build_number app_identifier:com.picklesensei` with an ASC API key.
- Real StoreKit behaviour of the appl_ key / entitlement pickle_sensei_pro: sandbox purchase on a device or simulator via `scripts/mac-full-verify.sh` (do NOT run --remote; coordinator-owned runner).
- Whether RevenueCat dashboard's appl_ key, entitlement and offering match the dossier: RevenueCat dashboard (credentials not available here).

Out of scope / not attacked: production Supabase, App Store Connect, secrets, network paths (release-config area is static configuration; 'network loss / slow response / account switch' conditions do not apply to these gates beyond the process-death and double-action cases exercised).
